description: Independent participating whole life insurance agency. Not affiliated with Bank on Yourself or Infinite Banking Concepts, LLC. Specializes in designing policies for maximum cash value rather than just selling them.
mission: Help people keep more of the money they make, grow their wealth, and have financial peace of mind.
two_criteria: Is it affordable? If you can't pay the premium, you can't do it.
Is it comfortable? If it makes you uneasy, you won't stick with it.
key_differentiators: Independent (not affiliated with Bank on Yourself or Infinite Banking Concepts, LLC)
Specializes in designing policies for maximum cash value, not just selling them
Positions life insurance as a financial asset, not an investment (U.S. Supreme Court agrees)
Can work with any life insurance company to find the best fit
